title: Design: A/R Detail invoice numbers are blue links, credit memos plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations: your current location and your other location.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations, so an invoice at your other location is a link.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with an open invoice made at your other location, more than 90 days past due.
  • Have a customer, customer B, with an unused credit memo at your current location, more than 90 days past due.
  • Have a customer, customer C, with an open invoice at your current location, more than 90 days past due.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the "91 or more days past due" bucket expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Read the header row, letter for letter.
  2. Look at customer A's invoice number, customer B's credit memo number and customer C's invoice number.
  3. Look at the subtotal row at the end of the bucket.
  4. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The chevron, then the columns in this order, letter for letter: "Date", "Location", "Transaction Type", "ID", "Customer Full Name" (with a small up arrow), "Due Date", "Amount", "Open Balance".
  • This report has no Past Due column.

Step 2:

  • Customer A's is a blue link (another location you work at).
  • Customer B's is plain dark text, not blue.
  • Customer C's is a blue link.
  • The links are semi-bold and not underlined.

Step 3:

  • "Total for 91 or more days past due" with the Amount and Open Balance sums in bold.

Step 4:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • The layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R1: “A document number is a link only when the user has the permission to open it and can open it in its own location; otherwise it shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R3: “An invoice or part sale at another location the user is enrolled in shows the existing location-switch prompt on the report, before leaving it: title "Switch location?", message "This work order is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?" (for a part sale: "This part sale is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?"), buttons "Cancel" on the left and "Switch location" on the right, and a close × at the top right.”
  • S7-R10: “A/R credit memos and deposits show as plain text: they have no page of their own.”
  • S2-R1, A/R Detail columns: “A/R Detail: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, ID, Customer Full Name, Due Date, Amount, Open Balance.”
  • S1-R5: “A/R Detail and A/P Detail keep their aging buckets in this fixed order: "91 or more days past due", "61-90 days past due", "31-60 days past due", "1-30 days past due", "Current". Inside each bucket, rows open in customer or vendor name order (S1-R2 to S1-R4), ties by document number (S2-R4).”
  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p5-every-invoice-number-is-a-link.png: figure "Every invoice number is a link" (Production (before)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "A number links only with the right permission and a location the user works at; otherwise plain text. Native link style: the Work In Progress blue, semi-bold, no underline. Reshot 2026-10-23 (round 15). S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R6, S7-R7, S7-N1, S7-N2." (caption of "Links only where they can open")
  • "Signed in to Heavy Duty, the Lethbridge invoices (S3-) are links too." (caption of "Every invoice number is a link")

The design version of 5 Nov 2026 replaced the picture "Links only where they can open" (reshot 23 Oct 2026, round 15). The old picture ar-ap-p5-links-only-where-they-can-open.png is no longer attached to this case; the new picture will be attached later.

Difference from the PRD (DD-01), closed: PRD version 5 said buttons "Switch location" and "Cancel" (S7-R3), title "Switch location?"; the design shows buttons "Cancel" (left, grey) then "Switch Location" (right, blue, capital L), and a close "×" at the top right of the dialog; caption: "Switch Location opens it there.". Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 11): the existing prompt keeps "Cancel" on the left, "Switch location" (small l) on the right and a close × at the top right, and the × closes it like Cancel; the capital L the picture and the current build show is a build bug to fix. PRD version 9 (S7-R3, S7-R5) now says so, and this case follows PRD version 9. The held design-version case D-76 (C715558) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).

Difference from the PRD (DD-05), closed: PRD version 5 said "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 15): semi-bold, exactly as Work In Progress links look today. The design's "Links only where they can open" picture was reshot on 23 Oct 2026 (round 15) and published on 5 Nov 2026; its caption now reads "Native link style: the Work In Progress blue, semi-bold, no underline." This case follows the PRD (S7-R7, unchanged in version 11). The held design-version case D-80 (C715562) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).

Difference from the PRD (DD-06), closed: PRD version 5 said A/R Detail and A/R Collection headings written "Transaction type", "Customer full name", "Due date", "Past due", "Open balance" (S2-R1); the design shows the after pictures read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Open Balance"; today's production pictures already read the same, with "Location Full Name". Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 4): Title Case on all six reports, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV, as the design shows; PRD version 9 adds S2-R4a and writes S2-R1 in Title Case. The design's version is now the requirement and this case follows PRD version 9; D-81 (C715563), held until then, is now a normal design case.

Difference from the PRD (DD-07), closed: PRD version 10 (4 Nov 2026) says Transaction Type "names each kind of credit: "Credit Memo" and "Deposit" on A/R, "Vendor Credit" on A/P" (S2-R1b); the design shows Transaction Type "Credit" on every credit memo, deposit and vendor credit row (for example in "Expand all from the header", "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices", "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible", "Cancel stays on the report" and "Vendor credits link"). Closed by the later PRD ruling: PRD version 10 (4 Nov 2026, Chris Ward, the design authority) added S2-R1b after these pictures were taken and lists it under What changes for existing users ("today all three read "Credit""); version 11 keeps it. Compare the layout with the pictures; the Transaction Type words come from the PRD.
